from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,signal,json
repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe');base='3447fb079b463a43d5dc59bb68e35f4f129475a1'
def git(*a):return subprocess.run(['git',*a],cwd=repo,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip()
if git('rev-parse','HEAD')!=base:raise SystemExit('AUTHORITY_CHANGED')
code=r'''
import asyncio,json
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
from tools.live_ats_inspect import allowed_url
from tools.ats_field_labels import extract_field_labels
url="https://jobs.lever.co/ethena/f85bcfd1-8d2c-4cf5-a6ab-1c8ddab14c65/apply"
async def main():
 async with async_playwright() as pw:
  browser=await pw.chromium.launch(headless=True)
  try:
   page=await browser.new_page(accept_downloads=False)
   async def guard(route):
    if route.request.is_navigation_request() and not allowed_url(route.request.url):await route.abort()
    else:await route.continue_()
   await page.route("**/*",guard)
   response=await page.goto(url,wait_until="domcontentloaded",timeout=25000)
   await page.wait_for_timeout(2500)
   if not allowed_url(page.url):raise RuntimeError("UNAPPROVED_FINAL_URL")
   fields=await extract_field_labels(page)
   ambiguous=[{"type":f["type"],"label":f["label"]} for f in fields if f["ambiguous"]]
   grouped=[{"type":f["type"],"label":f["label"],"question":f["question"]} for f in fields if f["question"]]
   required=[{"type":f["type"],"label":f["label"],"question":f["question"],"ambiguous":f["ambiguous"]} for f in fields if f["required"]]
   print(json.dumps({"status":response.status if response else None,"total":len(fields),"grouped_count":len(grouped),"grouped":grouped[:25],"ambiguous_count":len(ambiguous),"ambiguous":ambiguous[:25],"required_count":len(required),"required":required[:25],"fill":"not_attempted","auth":"not_attempted","submit":"not_attempted","review":"not_verified"},sort_keys=True))
  finally:await browser.close()
asyncio.run(main())
'''
p=subprocess.Popen([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-c',code],cwd=repo,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,start_new_session=True)
try:o,e=p.communicate(timeout=75)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
 os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL);raise SystemExit('TIMEOUT')
print('EXIT',p.returncode,'OUTPUT',o[-10000:],'STDERR',e[-600:],flush=True)
if p.returncode:raise SystemExit('LIVE_INSPECTION_FAILED')
d=json.loads(o)
assert d['status']==200 and d['total']>0
assert d['fill']=='not_attempted' and d['auth']=='not_attempted' and d['submit']=='not_attempted'
assert git('rev-parse','HEAD')==base
print('LIVE_READONLY_QUESTION_MAPPING_VERIFIED',flush=True)
